title: Settings Account Security
summary: Give users clear control over credentials, sessions, and recovery without burying critical protections.

strategies.name: Security checkup checklist
strategies.tradeoffs: Improves hygiene; can alarm low-risk users.
strategies.when: Consumer apps after breach waves or high-value accounts.

strategies.name: Passkey-primary with password fallback
strategies.tradeoffs: Phishing resistance; device recovery education needed.
strategies.when: Modern auth stacks with WebAuthn support.

strategies.name: Session list with remote revoke
strategies.tradeoffs: Transparency; support load from confused revokes.
strategies.when: Multi-device products and shared computer risk.

strategies.name: Step-up auth for sensitive changes
strategies.tradeoffs: Security win; friction on email/phone updates.
strategies.when: Any product where account takeover has real cost.

neverDo: Store recovery codes only as a transient toast
Mix billing settings into security without labels
Use scary red everywhere so danger zone loses meaning
evidenceNotes: Compiled from captured app journeys + curated designer wisdom.
